senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ष्ठन्-ष्ठन्ती-ष्ठत्)
Staying, abiding, standing, being.
E.
स्था to stay, &c. शतृ aff.

n. (-द्गु)
Evening, sun-set, the time which a cow stands to be milked, &c.
E.
स्था to stand, गौ a cow.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Auspicious, fortunate, lucky.
m. (-ष्यः)
1 The eighth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, an asterism figured by an arrow, and containing three stars, of which one is δ Cancri.
2 The month Pauṣa, (December-January.)
3 The Kali Yug, the fourth and present age.
f. (-ष्या)
Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
E.
तुष to please or delight, affix क्यप्, and इत् substituted for the penultimate.

m. (-कः)
The month Pauṣa: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to तिष्य, the moon being then in that asterism.

f. (-ष्पा)
Emblic myrobalan.
E.
तिष्य auspicious, and पुष्प a flower.

f. (-ला)
Emblic myrobalan: see तिष्य.
E.
तिष्य auspicious, and फल fruit.
